source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion: Gather witness statements (where applicable), attach to form. 3. Complete form (refer to note below regarding reporting of serious accidents). 4. Send completed form to group administration within 3 days of the incident. 5. Group administration will report to the Dept. of Labor if the accident is reportable within 24 hours of when the incident occurred. We will use the timeline for a serious injury to report a fatality. This will allow us to provide an accurate and thorough report. 6. Please don't hesitate to contact Karen or Sharon with any questions. Note: Serious accidents/injuries include any hospitalization related to a workplace accident, broken bones, etc. Please document these with the supervisor before the end of the shift.
